sentiment.rationale: The document reports a strong Q1 with EPS of $1.23 beating consensus of $0.77 (59.74% surprise) and revenue of $12,249.76M beating consensus of $12,173.11M. However, full-year guidance is maintained, not raised: revenue growth of 12%-14% and operating margin of 31.5% are reaffirmed. Management expresses confidence in the business and highlights strong engagement metrics (member quality metric at an all-time high) and advertising growth (doubling to ~$3B). The score is mildly positive because the quarter's beat is backward-looking and guidance is unchanged, but the underlying operational momentum (record engagement, strong ad growth, confident forward language) justifies a small positive score above 0.0.

summary.revenue: FQ1 2026 revenue of $12,249.76 million, beating consensus of $12,173.11 million (0.63% surprise). Full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance of 12% to 14%.
summary.eps: FQ1 2026 EPS normalized of $1.23, beating consensus of $0.77 (59.74% surprise).
summary.guidance: Maintaining full-year 2026 guidance: revenue growth of 12% to 14%, operating margin at 31.5%, advertising revenue roughly doubling to about $3 billion.
key_risks: Warner Bros. deal costs: $275 million of M&A-related costs carried in initial guidance, with some costs pulled forward into 2026 from 2027.
Nielsen methodology change: reduces weight of streaming in their gauge, but management states it does not affect actual viewing or advertising revenue.
key_opportunities: Advertising business: expected to roughly double to about $3 billion in 2026.
Engagement: primary member quality metric hit another all-time high in Q1 2026.
Live events: World Baseball Classic drove largest single sign-up day ever in Japan and Japan's highest quarter of paid net adds.
Games: new kids gaming app (Netflix Playground) and continued investment in gaming.
AI: acquisition of InterPositive to accelerate GenAI capabilities for content creation.
Podcasting: gaining incremental engagement, especially daytime and mobile viewing.
International growth: APAC was strongest FX-neutral revenue growth market, with strong performance in India, Korea, and Southeast Asia.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management uses phrases like 'really great about the business,' 'tons of room for growth still ahead of us,' and 'we feel great about the business, about the organic growth opportunity ahead,' indicating strong confidence.
